title: REQ · History load failure shows an explained error with Retry
summary: Error message and Retry button when listMine fails; Retry reloads history
description: Context: the catch in the history effect is empty so failures are invisible. Desired behavior: on rejection show 'Could not load your suggestions' (role alert) and a Retry button that re-runs listMine and returns to loading, then ready. Why: players can recover without closing the sheet.
acceptance_criteria: Given listMine rejects, when loading ends, then role alert text 'Could not load your suggestions' and a button named Retry are visible
Given the error state, when Retry is clicked and listMine then resolves, then listMine was called twice and the history list renders without the error

preserve: Submit still works when history failed

technical_constraints: Retry re-triggers the existing effect via a reload counter
